scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Scheme Of Festival Assistance For Participating In International & National Festival
other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident/domicile of the State of Manipur.

For International Festival assistance, the artist or group must have performed in at least two‑thirds of the National Festivals recognized by the National Academies, Zonal Cultural Centres, Ministry of Culture, or State Culture Department.
For International Festival assistance, the artist or group must have participated in three‑quarters of the State Level programmes.
For National Festival assistance, the artist or group must have performed in at least three‑quarters of recognized National Festivals.
For National Festival assistance, the artist or group must have participated in three‑quarters of the State Level programmes.
The applicant or group must not have been wholly sponsored by any individual or institution for the same purpose.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance reimbursed for travel, visa and related expenses, supporting up to three individual artists and three cultural groups per year for both international and national festivals.
documents_required: Printed application form (as per scheme guidelines)
Cover letter addressed to the Director (Art & Culture)
